items.headline: Hormuz tanker rates hit record highs
items.summary: Freight rates for crossing the Strait of Hormuz have surged to roughly $1.3 million a day versus $20,000-50,000 pre-war, with some refiners seeing margins compressed as shipping costs eat into crude processing economics.

items.headline: Gen10 adds Citi commodities veteran to board
items.summary: Agentic CTRM vendor Gen10 appointed Citibank's Global Head of Commodities, Jose Cogolludo, to its advisory board as the firm positions its chat-driven CommOS platform against legacy CTRM systems.

items.headline: Poll: AI interest outpaces CTRM upgrades
items.summary: An ION Commodities poll of 105 industry respondents found 64% cite AI/machine learning as the technology area generating most interest, far ahead of CTRM systems (8%) and data analytics (7%), with buyers favoring flexible AI-ready platforms over embedded models.

items.headline: REMIT II reporting rules now in force
items.summary: The EU's recast REMIT Implementing Regulation and new Delegated Regulation took effect, broadening scope to balancing services, storage and hydrogen while shortening reporting deadlines and introducing forward-looking exposure obligations for energy traders.
